newsitem.title: PERU: Peru negotiator arrives for hostage talks.
newsitem.headline: Peru negotiator arrives for hostage talks.

text.p: Peruvian government negotiator Domingo Palermo arrived on Saturday at the besieged Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima where he was expected to hold a third round of talks with Marxist rebels holding 72 hostages.
The first two formal meetings between Palermo and the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) were held on Friday and on Tuesday in a safe house opposite the residence.

The three members of a mediating panel overseeing the talks -- Canadian ambassador Anthony Vincent, Red Cross representative Michel Minnig and Roman Catholic bishop Juan Luis Cipriani -- also arrived at the site along with Japanese crisis talks' observer Teruke Terada.
Palermo was expected to meet again with the MRTA 's No. 2, Rolly Rojas, who has been designated to negotiate for the rebels during the "preliminary" stage of talks.
All sides have agreed a pact of silence on the details of the talks.
